setup: [ -e cloud/.git ] || git clone -q --branch dev "$(git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#/rerun(\.git)?$#/rerun-cloud.git#')" cloud || echo '[setup] cloud/ not cloned: open source build only'

for source in "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH"/apps/*/.env "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH"/apps/*/.env.local "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH"/apps/*/.env.profile.* "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH"/cloud/apps/*/.env "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH"/cloud/apps/*/.env.local "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH"/cloud/apps/*/.env.profile.*; do [ -f "$source" ] || continue; target="${source#"$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH"/}"; [ -d "$(dirname "$target")" ] || continue; [ -e "$target" ] || cp "$source" "$target"; done
pnpm install --force --ignore-scripts && pnpm rebuild esbuild sharp && pnpm --filter @rerun/contracts build

emails.command: EMAIL_ASSET_ORIGIN=http://localhost:$(bash scripts/paseo/workspace-port.sh) pnpm --filter @rerun/emails exec email dev --dir emails --port $PASEO_PORT

everything.command: port=$(bash scripts/paseo/workspace-port.sh) && PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH pnpm exec concurrently -k -n ui,landing,engine,emails,stripe,trigger -c cyan,blue,green,gray,magenta,yellow "pnpm --filter rerun exec next dev -p $port" "pnpm --dir cloud/apps/landing exec next dev -p $((port + 1))" "pnpm dev:engine" "EMAIL_ASSET_ORIGIN=http://localhost:$port pnpm --filter @rerun/emails exec email dev --dir emails --port $((port + 3))" "stripe listen --forward-to localhost:$port/api/webhooks/stripe --forward-connect-to localhost:$port/api/webhooks/stripe/connect" "pnpm cloud trigger:dev"

cloud-diff.command: [ -e cloud/.git ] || { echo 'No cloud/ in this workspace'; exit 0; }; git -C cloud fetch -q origin dev; base=$(git -C cloud merge-base origin/dev HEAD); git -C cloud log --oneline "$base"..HEAD; git -C cloud status -sb; git -C cloud -c color.ui=always diff --stat "$base"; git -C cloud -c color.ui=always diff "$base"

title.instructions: A few words in French, no leading verb.

commitMessage.instructions: In English, Conventional Commits with a scope, lowercase subject, no final period: `fix(engine): free root's node caches after each update`.

pullRequest.instructions: In English, the repository is public. Title in Conventional Commits with a scope, like `feat(phone): the signup wall takes the number without a code`. The body says what changes and why in a few short paragraphs, then ends with a "Tested" section saying what was checked in the running app and how.
